title: A stood pick goes with Send only after the owner has opened its card
why: Owner 12:25 CST Nov 12: "a lot of the keep the picks were pre selected and i didn't realize that before reviewing and so i never got to see them before i hit send answers on them".
note: Mistake: the page sends a `stands` item's pick with the owner's next Send (skill waiting-page, "Add an item"), so 25 coordinator picks posted 12:13-12:22 CST rode one Send at 12:24 CST unseen; triage closed them, then reopened all 25 at 12:26 CST. Fix: a stood pick is sent only once its card was opened or expanded, or the Send shows a count of unseen stood picks and leaves them out. Red first on a page test. Until it lands, triage closes no stands item from a Send that carries more than its own visible picks. Second symptom, owner 12:29 CST Nov 12: the page said "Too late to undo" on 14 items (560, 561, 567-569, 571, 573, 574, 576, 578, 581, 582, 585, 586) after triage had closed them, and it did not show them reopened. Fix also: the writer reopening an item re-enables its Undo, and the page shows the reopen without a reload. Third symptom, 12:34 CST Nov 12: reopening an item left its answers/<id> record in place, so the page kept 14 cards as sent ("Too late to undo"). Triage deleted the 14 records 12:34 CST (copies in its scratchpad). Fix also: a reopen deletes the answer record in the same write; a check refuses an open item that still has one. Fourth sighting 13:15 CST Nov 12: item 542 (reworded at 12:00 CST after the owner's 11:59 answer) stayed hidden because its answers record was never deleted; owner: "i dont see item 542". Cleared. Six more open items are hidden by answers records holding unfiled owner answers (240, 324, 328, 354, 398, 476); triage files those. A reword that reopens an item must delete its answers record in the same write.
